description: Per-system architecture atlas document — one file per tracked system boundary, authored inside docs/architecture/systems/. Carries two distinct clocks per the two-clock split (atlas-watch-script-convention.md): last_mapped (most recent body rewrite) and last_attested (targeted audit clock, on-diff passes). /architecture-survey writes last_mapped only and carries an existing last_attested forward verbatim; /architecture-audit writes last_attested (Branch A bumps both clocks, Branch B bumps last_attested only). A page never targeted by /architecture-audit has no last_attested. Spec backlink: coordinator/docs/wiki/schema-and-validation-contracts/canonical-artifact-shapes.md § Atlas documents.

last_mapped.description: Date of the last full atlas re-bootstrap that wrote this file (YYYY-MM-DD). Survey clock — updated by every /architecture-survey pass (full or refresh) that rewrites the page, and by an /architecture-audit Branch A rotation. Branch B never bumps it.

mode.description: Description of the run mode that produced this file. Free-form; for observability only.

last_attested.description: Date of the last targeted on-diff audit for this system (YYYY-MM-DD). Targeted-audit clock — updated by /architecture-audit but NOT by /architecture-survey, full or refresh; a survey carries an existing value forward verbatim. Absent on pages never audited. Distinct from last_mapped — do NOT conflate.

system.description: System name this document covers. Matches the filename stem (e.g. 'coordinator-pipeline' for coordinator-pipeline.md).
